question: According to Hebrews 7:25, why is Jesus able to save completely those who come to God through him?
options: Because he was born in Bethlehem
Because he lived in the temple
Because he always lives to intercede for them
Because he gave them the law
explanation: Hebrews 7:25 says Jesus is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.
